usage: lara (check|deps|map-input) <file.sexp|file.lara|file.laramap>; lara check <file> --out <path> (write the accepted verdict to <path>)
notes: The executable is a local cabal build (GHC 9.14.1, dist-newstyle/build/aarch64-osx/ghc-9.14.1/lara-0.1.0.0/x/lara/build/lara/lara) of the inspected source commit, not a release artifact.
The binary prints no version string: '--version' and '--help' both print the usage line above and exit 2, so the source commit and executable digest are the only identity.
Verdicts name lara-core@0.2 in their replay identity; backends and theories are selected per check and recorded in each ara.lara-argument-check/v1 record, not here.

Registration of a scored study must re-pin a release executable (its own digest and platform) built from a reviewed source commit; this local pin is valid only for contract tests and the L2 adapter smoke.
A runner refuses to run an executable whose SHA-256 differs from the pin and records the check as unavailable.
